data.narrative:
Stratek Global is a growth-stage nuclear energy company founded by Kelvin Kemm. The valuation exercise draws from a broader nuclear energy comp universe of 11 peers: 3 public entities (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies, including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

The peer-median method is not applicable here. While 6 same-sector nuclear energy peers exist, none satisfy the filtering criteria for stage alignment or valuation-tier similarity required for a robust median benchmark. Specifically, the narrow peer set yielded fewer than 3 datapoints across same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-tier classifications. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias and obscure sector-specific dynamics. Consequently, this analysis cannot rely on conventional comparable company triangulation.

The absence of a sufficiently granular peer cohort represents the primary analytical constraint. Without disclosed valuation data for Stratek Global or sufficient same-stage nuclear energy companies at comparable scales, traditional multiples-based valuation cannot be defensibly applied. Resolution would require either (1) access to recent financing rounds for private peers, (2) disclosure of Stratek's revenue or EBITDA, or (3) identification of additional growth-stage nuclear peers. Until one of these conditions is met, a quantitative valuation range cannot be supported by the available data.
